name: Loan for the Purchase of Work Tool for the Construction Workers
benefit: - An amount not exceeding ₹20,000/- may be sanctioned as loan to the members of the fund, for the purchase of work related tools. **Note:** The loan amount shall be recovered in not more than sixty installments.
_eligibility_text:
> **For Registration:** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 65 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.
> **For Application:** - The applicant should be registered under the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for not less than one year. - The applicant should remit their contribution regularly. - The applicant should not exceed 55 years of age.
